title: Twitch Streamer Mitch Jones faces legal threat after recreating $500K Deal or No Deal game show
summary_full: Twitch streamer Mitch Jones says he received a cease and desist just days after hosting a real-life version of Deal or No Deal featuring Sodapoppin, Nmplol, and cash prizes worth up to $500,000. According to Mitch, the official production demanded money over the unauthorized recreation of the show's format. No lawsuit has been reported so far, and there has been no public resolution as of July 30.
